name: Walker
description: Walker is a half-elf dragon rider and fighter. During the session on 2026-08-03, he returns the Midgar keystone to Plymouth Gawater so it can be formally bestowed upon Gerk. Plymouth then offers Walker stewardship of the Keystone of La-rel, noting that he is the only party member not originally from Midgar; Walker declines, even though La-rel is his birthplace. After reflecting with Glimmen, he concludes that the Reach has become his true home and that La-rel, while still important to him, no longer defines who he is. He accepts the Keystone of the Reach and chooses to protect the Reach rather than La-rel. Later, Walker recognizes a distinctive tree from his past travels, helping confirm that a portal exits near Langdale. When Plymouth asks how he is able to create portals, Walker avoids giving a real explanation.
